components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Committed action for upload, create, save, continue, or send.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4cceac; color: #141b2d; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 24px; font: 900 10px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #45b89c; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(76,206,172,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(76,206,172,0.75); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Utility action in dense forms, popovers, and admin panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #e5e7eb; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 800 10px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(76,206,172,0.65); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Top-bar search/input treatment with panel slate background and teal focus.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 320px; max-width: 100%; background: rgba(31,42,64,0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; color: #e0e0e0; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #e0e0e0; font: 500 14px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-search-icon { color: #a3a3a3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: rgba(76,206,172,0.5); } .ds-search:focus-within .ds-search-icon { color: #4cceac; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected sidebar route with teal text, tint, and leading active indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; background: rgba(76,206,172,0.1); color: #4cceac; text-decoration: none; font: 700 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-active:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: rgba(76,206,172,0.14); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(76,206,172,0.7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-marker { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 4px; height: 24px; border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; background: #4cceac; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(76,206,172,0.5); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; text-align: center; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(76,206,172,0.35)); }

components.html:
Creative ops

Demo workspace

Manage files, previews, documents, and AI-assisted workflow support from one focused surface.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: min(420px, 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 24px; background: rgba(26,35,54,0.75); color: #e0e0e0; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-label { margin: 0 0 10px; color: #4cceac; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; color: #ffffff; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 800; } .ds-panel p:last-child { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #a3a3a3; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact state indicator for online, role, permission, or workflow status.
components.css: .ds-chip-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(76,206,172,0.35); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(76,206,172,0.1); color: #4cceac; padding: 4px 10px; font: 800 10px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip-status span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #4cceac; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(76,206,172,0.55); }

narrative.overview:
NewDashboardYomedia is a dark-first internal product system for YoMedia teams who manage creative, demo, document, AI, and admin work throughout the day. The visual language should feel like a focused operations studio: composed, fast, and practical, with enough creative polish to match the ad-creative domain without turning the interface into a marketing surface.

The current system uses a slate-blue workspace, a restrained teal operational accent, system sans typography, rounded product containers, light tonal borders, and motion/react feedback. Future design work should preserve this identity while tightening consistency: the product should not become a generic SaaS admin template, a flashy AI toy, a chatbot-first playground, a dense enterprise back-office system, an overly colorful marketing website, or a complicated dashboard overloaded with widgets.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first slate workspace with a light theme fallback.
Teal accent for primary actions, active navigation, focus, status, and meaningful confirmation.
Dense but readable product UI for daily internal work.
Rounded, bordered panels with tonal layering rather than heavy decorative shadows.
Motion used for state, hierarchy, and feedback, not page-load choreography.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Studio Teal is a signal, not decoration. Use it for action, selection, focus, and operational status; avoid spraying it across inactive cards.

rules.name: The Slate Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth starts with tonal slate layers and borders. Reach for shadows only when a surface floats above the app or needs hover feedback.

rules.name: The Product Sans Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display fonts for labels, buttons, data, tables, or admin controls. One tuned system sans family is the product default.

rules.name: The Label Restraint Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels are useful in dense admin UI, but they must mark structure or status. Do not add tiny uppercase eyebrow text above every content block.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Use background layer, border, and state color before adding a shadow. If every card floats, no card is important.

rules.name: The No Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Do not pair a decorative 1px border with a broad soft shadow on ordinary controls. For product surfaces, choose a quiet border or a purposeful lift.

dos: Do preserve the product-register feel: a clean internal creative operations dashboard for daily YoMedia work.
Do use Studio Teal for primary actions, active navigation, focus, selected states, and meaningful status.
Do keep AI/RAG surfaces practical and workflow-supportive rather than chatbot-first.
Do support both dark and light theme behavior when changing shared components.
Do keep table, file, document, brand, user, and admin workflows dense enough for operators while maintaining readable spacing.
Do include loading, empty, error, disabled, hover, focus, and active states for interactive components.
Do use system sans typography for product UI and font-mono only for paths, code, IDs, and technical values.
donts: Don't make the interface feel like a generic SaaS admin template.
Don't make it feel like a flashy AI toy or chatbot-first playground.
Don't make it feel like a dense enterprise back-office system.
Don't turn the product into an overly colorful marketing website.
Don't overload the dashboard with too many widgets.
Don't use gradient text; the current dashboard accent headline should be treated as legacy, not a pattern to repeat.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders greater than 1px as card accents.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism as the default surface treatment.
Don't invent custom affordances for standard controls when native buttons, inputs, select menus, tabs, or tables are clearer.
